content.value: The annual incomes of some composite textile factories are approximately normally 15 distributed with a mean of \$50,000 and a standard deviation of \$20,000. Calculate (i) what percentage of factory earn between \$45,000 and \$65,000? (ii) what is the probabilities of earning 99% of the income? (iii) what is the probabilities of earning 68% of the income?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
